## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2 / −1.2×10¹² (run-5 calibration)

**Read (both runs):** the device is high quality at base temperature. Oscillations appear at ≤ 0.5 T, and on the electron side Rxx drops to ≈ 0 (quantum Hall) at many fields between 1.5 and 7 T. **Run 6 (n = +3.2):** the strongest tones are **7.2, 22.2 and 30 T**. 7.2 + 22.2 = 29.4 ≈ 30 T, which is what an ABAB two-band pair looks like (light + heavy = F_L). But 22.2 ≈ 3 × 7.2 and 30 ≈ 4 × 7.2, which is what one tone plus its harmonics looks like, and `sdh_onset` flags them as harmonics. A single density cannot separate the two readings; tracking each tone against n can. Also, 30 T is about 0.9 × F_L(prior scale) = 33.1 T, so the geometry-prior density scale may be about 10 % high; the QH lines in a fan will calibrate it. **Run 7 (n = −1.2, close to the CNP):** many tones between 3.5 and 22 T and no clean pair. This regime is complicated by the semimetal overlap and the region-B mosaic (its CNP is offset by −0.43×10¹²), so no read from it alone. **Verdict so far:** consistent with ABAB and with a single band plus harmonics. Not a call. Next: the D = 0 Landau fan (plan Step 4).

# Runs 6-7 — sdh-spot-check at D = 0 (region-A cal, run 5). Raw first, then FFT in 1/B (log R, B-space bg5).
import warnings
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, sdh_onset

def rxx_vs_B(rid):
    r = run(rid)
    ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col_at(1)                                   # planned setpoint column
    R = np.abs((r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain) / (r.col("sr0_X") / ch["sr0"].gain))
    o = np.argsort(B)
    return r, B[o], R[o]

h_over_4e = cst.h / (4 * cst.e)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 7.5))
for k, (rid, n12) in enumerate([(6, +3.2), (7, -1.2)]):
    r, B, R = rxx_vs_B(rid)
    FL = abs(n12) * 1e16 * h_over_4e
    print(f"run {rid}: n = {n12:+.1f}e12 (run-5 cal), {len(B)} pts, B {B.min():.2f}-{B.max():.2f} T, "
          f"R {R.min():.1f}-{R.max():.1f} Ohm, T {r.col('T_sample').min():.3f}-{r.col('T_sample').max():.3f} K, "
          f"I_tg {r.col('k_2400_tg_curr').min()*1e12:+.0f}..{r.col('k_2400_tg_curr').max()*1e12:+.0f} pA; F_L(prior scale) = {FL:.1f} T")
    ax[0, k].plot(B, R, lw=0.7); ax[0, k].set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax[0, k].set_ylabel("|Rxx| B_1-B_2 (Ohm)")
    ax[0, k].set_title(f"run {rid} raw — n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0")
    with warnings.catch_warnings():
        warnings.simplefilter("ignore")
        on = sdh_onset(R, B, b_lo=0.5, r_full_scale=50e-6 / 1e-8)
    print(on.summary())
    for br, c in [((1.5, 10.0), "C0"), ((2.0, 10.0), "C1")]:
        f, sp = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=br, nfft=4096, bg_degree=5); sp = sp[0]
        m = (f > 2) & (f < 70); ff, ss = f[m], sp[m]
        p, _ = find_peaks(ss, prominence=0.1 * ss.max())
        print(f"  FFT {br} T: peaks " + ", ".join(f"{ff[i]:.1f} T ({ss[i]/ss.max():.2f})" for i in p[np.argsort(-ss[p])][:6]))
        ax[1, k].plot(ff, ss / ss.max(), c, lw=0.8, label=f"B {br[0]}-{br[1]} T")
    ax[1, k].axvline(FL, color="k", ls=":", lw=1, label=f"F_L prior {FL:.1f} T")
    ax[1, k].set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax[1, k].set_ylabel("norm. |FFT|"); ax[1, k].legend(fontsize=8)
fig.suptitle("vti-02 SdH spot checks, D = 0: run 6 (e, +3.2e12, 0->10 T) and run 7 (h, -1.2e12, 10->0.3 T)")
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`), B 0.6 → 9 T × n −1.20 … +3.25×10¹²

> **05:24** · landau-fan D=0: B 0.6->9 T ascending (1/B-uniform 0.6-3 T d=0.0125/T, 0.1 T 3.1-9 T; 168 rows) x n -1.20..+3.25e12 on D=0 (91 pts, run-5 cal), fast\_delay 1 s, sr1 100 uV, Vsi 0; ends at 9 T · **ETA ~12:09** (≈6h45m)

**Why (plan Step 4).** Run 6 (n = +3.2×10¹²) shows tones at 7.2, 22.2 and 30 T. 7.2 + 22.2 ≈ 30 fits an ABAB light + heavy pair summing to F_L, but 22.2 ≈ 3 × 7.2 and 30 ≈ 4 × 7.2 also fit one tone plus harmonics (ana, runs 6–7). A single density can't separate these readings. The density dependence can: an independent band has its own F(n) slope and F₁ + F₂ = F_L(n) at every n, while a harmonic stays at exactly k × its parent. The fan also gives (i) the **absolute density scale** from the QH minima lines n = ν·eB/h (run 5's c_tg is still the geometry prior; 30 T ≈ 0.9 F_L suggests it is ~10 % high), (ii) the LL structure (ABAB: light/heavy LL crossings; ABCA: 16-fold zero LL, no crossings in the low-index fan at D = 0), and (iii) whether region B (CNP offset −0.43×10¹²) has its own fan.

**Geometry.** Fast: co-swept (V_tg, V_bg) on the region-A D = 0 line (run-5 cal), n = −1.20 … +3.25×10¹² in 91 points (Δn = 0.05×10¹²), hole → electron. That is the whole D = 0 window inside the validators (−1.28 … +3.26), 2–7 mV margin to the TG limit at each end. Slow: B ascending from where the magnet sits. **0.6 → 3 T uniform in 1/B** (108 rows, Δ(1/B) = 0.0125 T⁻¹, Nyquist 40 T > F_L max 33.6 T), then **0.1 T steps 3.1 → 9 T** (60 rows), 168 rows in all. **Coverage trade:** stopping at 9 T instead of the 10 T cap saves ~30 min. The stacking discriminators (tone slopes, low-index LL crossings) live below ~6 T. Ends at 9 T with gates at n = +3.25, where Step 5 (D-dependence at fixed B) starts without re-traversing.

**Settings.** fast_delay 1.0 s (≈ 3.3 τ at 0.3 s / 24 dB: a uniform ≈ 1-step lag toward +n, which leaves QH-line slopes and FFT frequencies untouched). slow_delay 3 s (10 τ after the row flyback) plus the magnet's 3 s settle. sr1 fixed at 100 µV = 10 kΩ full scale: runs 6–7 peaked ≤ 600 Ω and the run-5 map max was 3.1 kΩ. A ν = 0 insulating state near the CNP at high B may rail; that is accepted, and the rail is itself a reading. Measured field is recorded per point. The 1 nA gate-leak guard interrupts and leaves the gates in place.

**Price** (from measured overhead: run 5, 1.10 s/pt at fast_delay 1 s; run 6, 3 s settle per field set): 168 rows × (91 × 1.13 s + ~11 s turnaround) ≈ 5.3 h, plus the 9 T ramp ≈ 66 min, ≈ **6 h 25 m model, 6 h 45 m headline**.

**Checkpoints.** (1) First 2 rows at 0.6 T: R level and sensitivity, CNP peak near n ≈ 0 and the region-B peak near −0.43, I_drain ≈ 9.9 nA, gate currents at the pA floor. Abort on a rail off-CNP or a dead channel. (2) About 1 T (row ~53, ~1.9 h): partial FFT on landed rows, light tone vs n. (3) 3 T (row 108, ~4.2 h): full low-field SdH record. Continue to 9 T unless the tone map already decides it and the high-field fan adds nothing. The price of stopping there is the LL-crossing evidence.

# === Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`) — plan Step 4 ===
# slow: magnet.field ascending 0.6 -> 9 T (1/B-uniform 0.6-3 T, d(1/B) = 0.0125 /T; then 0.1 T steps 3.1-9 T)
# fast: co-swept (Vtg, Vbg) along the region-A D = 0 line, n = -1.20 ... +3.25e12, 91 pts (dn = 0.05e12), hole -> electron
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
from hera.analysis import field_invB

# --- session calibration (run 5, cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, absolute scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.linspace(-1.20, 3.25, 91)                                   # 1e12 cm^-2
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.zeros_like(n_vec), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX, \
    (Vtg_vec.min(), Vtg_vec.max(), Vbg_vec.min(), Vbg_vec.max())
_n_chk, _D_chk = calc_nD(Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert np.allclose(_n_chk, n_vec) and np.abs(_D_chk).max() < 1e-9

B_A = field_invB(0.6, 3.0, 108)                                        # 1/B-uniform, d(1/B) = 0.0125 /T (Nyquist 40 T)
B_B = np.round(np.arange(3.1, 9.0 + 1e-9, 0.1), 4)                     # 0.1 T steps
B_vec = np.hstack((B_A, B_B))
assert np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0) and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and B_vec.min() > 0
print(f"fast: {len(n_vec)} pts n {n_vec[0]:+.2f}..{n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 (dn {n_vec[1]-n_vec[0]:.3f}); "
      f"Vtg {Vtg_vec[0]:+.4f}..{Vtg_vec[-1]:+.4f}, Vbg {Vbg_vec[0]:+.4f}..{Vbg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V")
print(f"slow: {len(B_vec)} rows, B {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T ({len(B_A)} 1/B-uniform to 3 T, {len(B_B)} at 0.1 T)")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan starts at 0.6 T ascending), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, heater ranges {heater.sample_range()}/{heater.vaporizer_range()} (0/0)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5, f"T_sample {_T0} K off base"
assert abs(_B0) < 0.05, f"magnet not near 0: {_B0} T"
assert abs(k_si()) < 0.01, "Si gate not at 0"
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not 1"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert float(heater.sample_range()) == 0 and float(heater.vaporizer_range()) == 0, "heaters not off"
print(f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V @ {sr1.frequency()} Hz -> I_bias ~ {sr1.amplitude()/100e6*1e9:.1f} nA; "
      f"tau sr1 {sr1.time_constant()} s / {sr1.filter_slope()} dB, sr0 {sr0.time_constant()} s")
assert abs(sr1.amplitude() - 1.0) < 1e-3, "drive amplitude changed"

FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.0, 3.0      # 1.0 s ~ 3.3 tau (uniform lag ~1 step, hole->electron); 3 s = 10 tau after the row flyback
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity, no mid-row autorange: 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA (run-5 map max 3.1 kOhm; SdH/QH maxima <= 600 Ohm in runs 6-7).
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (10 kOhm FS); sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V; magnet settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = ("landau-fan D=0: B 0.6->9 T (1/B-uniform 0.6-3 T d=0.0125, 0.1 T 3.1-9 T, 168 rows) x "
                  "n -1.20..+3.25e12 on D=0 (91 pts, run-5 cal), Vsi 0, sr1 100 uV")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 fan: slow magnet.field 0.6 -> 9.0 T ascending, {len(B_vec)} rows (1/B-uniform 0.6-3 T d(1/B)=0.0125/T, then 0.1 T); '
              f'fast co-swept (Vtg, Vbg) on D = 0, n = {n_vec[0]:+.2f} .. {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12, {len(n_vec)} pts; '
              f'cal run 5: c_tg {CAL["c_tg"]:.4g}, c_bg {CAL["c_bg"]:.4g}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.4f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; '
              f'fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s, sr1 100 uV')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(set), Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, magnet.field(read), sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr).fp(magnet.field)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample); s.plot('time', magnet.field)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.3f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                 slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
# field stays at 9 T (plan Step 5 works there — no re-traverse); gates stay at the last fan point.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T = {T_sample():.3f} K")

# === SdH spot check, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`): n = +3.2e12 at D = 0 (region-A calibration), B 0 -> 10 T ===
